fields.label: Assign leads to the first agent page they visitWhen enabled, leads are assigned to the first agent page they visit on your site, overriding all other routing rules. Note: this applies even when the Agent Selector is hidden — hiding an agent only removes manual selection, not attribution.
Assign featured listing leads to the listing agentWhen enabled, leads on featured listings are always assigned to the listing agent, overriding all other routing rules except First Touch Attribution.

Assign leads based on listing postal codeWhen enabled, leads are assigned to agents based on the postal code of the listing they inquire about. An agent can be assigned multiple postal codes, but each postal code can only be assigned to one agent.

Assign leads to agents in rotating orderWhen enabled, leads are assigned to agents in a rotating order based on the list below. To create a weighted distribution, add an agent to the list more than once.
